0022600007.text: Denver opens its 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, and neither team has played a game this season yet. In the 2025-26 season series, Denver lost 1-3, but the Nuggets won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026. Spencer Jones is a game-time decision for Denver with a hamstring injury, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Nuggets a 25% chance to win.

0022600110.text: Neither the Nuggets nor the Pelicans has played a 2026-27 game yet, and the Nuggets are hosting this regular-season matchup. Denver won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 122-116 road win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver an 80% chance to win.

0022600127.text: The Nuggets host the Golden State Warriors, and neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 70% chance to win. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver won the most recent meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
